title: Where Were You on Tuesday?

pre.en: Where is Lily when she sends her last message?
pre.zh: Lily 发最后一条消息时在哪儿？

intro: 兄妹俩的聊天记录：Lily 发现小陈的健身包在门口放了两个星期没动，一条一条追问下去。读的时候留意 keep doing（老是做，常带抱怨）和 stop doing（别再做），再比较一下 stop to do（停下来去做另一件事）。最后一条消息有个小意外。

sentences.en: Quick question, out of curiosity.
sentences.zh: 问你个事，纯属好奇。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Has your gym bag moved since I arrived?
sentences.zh: 我来了以后，你那个健身包挪过地方吗？

sentences.en: It's been sitting by the door for two weeks with your trainers on top.
sentences.zh: 它在门口放了两个星期了，上面还压着你的球鞋。

sentences.en: And you keep saying "tomorrow".
sentences.zh: 你还老说「明天去」。

sentences.en: I went on Tuesday!
sentences.zh: 我周二去了！
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'm just not used to telling you every time I work out.
sentences.zh: 我只是不习惯每次健身都跟你报备。

sentences.en: According to your calendar, you had a session with Dan at seven on Tuesday.
sentences.zh: 你日历上写着，周二七点你跟 Dan 有节课。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: But you were home by half past six.
sentences.zh: 可你六点半就到家了。

sentences.en: And you were in a very good mood for someone who'd just done fifty squats.
sentences.zh: 一个刚做完五十个深蹲的人，心情未免也太好了。

sentences.en: OK, OK.
sentences.zh: 好吧好吧。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: On Tuesday I had a terrible headache, so I couldn't make it.
sentences.zh: 周二我头疼得厉害，就没去成。

sentences.en: And on Thursday my knee was hurting, and then it started raining.
sentences.zh: 周四我膝盖疼，后来又下雨了。

sentences.en: Dan keeps messaging me, by the way.
sentences.zh: 对了，Dan 一直给我发消息。

sentences.en: He wants to know where I am.
sentences.zh: 问我人去哪儿了。

sentences.en: Stop making excuses.
sentences.zh: 别找借口了。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Your knee was fine when you stopped to buy crisps at the corner shop.
sentences.zh: 你半路停下来去街角小店买薯片的时候，膝盖可好好的。

sentences.en: And it hardly ever rains inside a gym.
sentences.zh: 再说，健身房里面很少下雨吧。

sentences.en: You're out of shape, Chen.
sentences.zh: 你身材都走样了，哥。

sentences.en: Dan charges forty pounds a session.
sentences.zh: Dan 一节课收 40 英镑。

sentences.en: You're paying him to miss you.
sentences.zh: 你这是花钱让他想你。

sentences.en: Fine, I'll own up.
sentences.zh: 行，我坦白。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I skipped both sessions and watched two hours of cooking videos instead.
sentences.zh: 两节课我都翘了，在家看了两个小时的做饭视频。

sentences.en: I know that guy's recipes inside out now, if that helps.
sentences.zh: 那个人的菜谱我现在倒背如流，要是这能算点什么的话。

sentences.en: It doesn't.
sentences.zh: 不算。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: So when exactly are you going to get round to going back?
sentences.zh: 那你到底打算什么时候回去？

sentences.en: Dan's got a class at seven on Monday morning, and I'm going.
sentences.zh: Dan 周一早上七点有节课，我要去。

sentences.en: Count me in.
sentences.zh: 算我一个。
sentences.speaker: Chen

sentences.en: I'll get back into it slowly.
sentences.zh: 我慢慢重新练起来。

sentences.en: And you can talk me into staying for the whole hour.
sentences.zh: 到时候你负责劝我把一整个小时练完。

sentences.en: Deal.
sentences.zh: 一言为定。
sentences.speaker: Lily

sentences.en: Guess where I am right now!
sentences.zh: 猜猜我现在在哪儿！

sentences.en: I used your guest pass and introduced myself to Dan.
sentences.zh: 我用了你的访客卡，还跟 Dan 做了自我介绍。

sentences.en: He says hi.
sentences.zh: 他让我跟你问好。

sentences.en: He also says you owe him fifty squats.
sentences.zh: 他还说，你欠他五十个深蹲。

cards.note: because you want to know something, not for any special reason
to do exercise to make your body stronger and fitter
cards.tip: 名词连写：a workout（一次锻炼）。work out 还有「算出来、想明白」的意思，看上下文。
cards.example: She works out three times a week before work.

cards.note: as shown by a report, a study or what someone has said
健身房按次收费说 per session / a session。
to feel happy and friendly
单数 squat；做深蹲是 do squats。
to succeed in arriving somewhere, especially in time or after a difficult journey
used to add something, often on a different subject
to give a reason for something you did or did not do, which is often not the true reason
cards.tip: 动词用 make，不用 find；为什么事找借口用 for：make excuses for being late。
cards.example: He always makes an excuse when it's his turn to cook.

cards.note: 英式说法；美式叫 chips，而英式的 chips 是炸薯条。
to not be fit because you have not exercised enough
cards.tip: 说人，指体能差，不一定是胖；反义是 be in (good) shape。
cards.example: I was so out of shape that I couldn't run for the bus.

cards.note: to admit that you did something wrong
cards.tip: 承认什么用 to + 名词 / doing：own up to breaking it。比 admit 口语。
cards.example: Nobody owned up to eating the last piece of cake.

cards.note: skip breakfast（不吃早饭）、skip a class（翘课）；过去式双写 p。
to know everything about something
cards.tip: inside out 本义是「里朝外」：wear your jumper inside out（毛衣穿反了）。
cards.example: She knows this city inside out.

cards.note: 读 /ˈresəpi/，三个音节，最后的 e 要读出来。
to finally do something that you have wanted or planned to do for a long time
used to say that you want to join an activity or plan
cards.tip: 反过来说不参加：Count me out。
cards.example: Pizza after work? Count me in.

cards.zh: 重新开始（做一件停了一阵的事）
cards.note: to start doing an activity again after a break
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing：get back into yoga / get back into reading。
cards.example: After the baby was born, it took me a year to get back into running.

cards.note: to persuade someone to do something
cards.tip: 后面接名词或 doing；反过来「劝某人别做」是 talk sb out of doing。
cards.example: My friends talked me into joining the choir.

cards.note: 会员可以带朋友进去一次的通行证。
to tell someone your name when you meet them for the first time
cards.tip: yourself 要跟着主语换：I introduced myself / she introduced herself；对谁介绍用 to。
cards.example: Let me introduce myself — I'm the new office manager.
